subject: Renewal QBR — compressed 'Showcase Day' scheduling & host rotation
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@brightmed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightMed Scheduling <scheduling@brightmed.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@brightmed.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightMed Renewal QBR - Prefer condensed day?

Hey Karthik,

Thanks again for the partnership — we're kicking off renewal planning and would like to keep the QBR condensed this year. Instead of a full-day workshop, our execs prefer a single "Showcase Day": three focused demo blocks (30–45m each) that we can pipe into the same calendar day. That helps avoid multi-day travel and keeps stakeholders engaged.

Can Redwood support a compressed schedule like that and provide a small runbook for ops (recording permissions, host rotation, backup hosts)? Attached is our team's rough availability for late August (BrightMed_availability.csv).

Primary asks:
- Can you confirm which morning/evening windows you can staff from Redwood? We are US/PST-centric but have one APAC observer.
- Can we request a short API walkthrough during the second block (15 min tech deep-dive)?
- Recording consent and attendee permission flow — we'll need an explicit opt-in for execs.

Appreciate it — cc'ing our scheduler Carlos so he can lock the calendar once we agree.

Best,
Alice
Head of Customer Success, BrightMed

Attachments: BrightMed_availability.csv (CSV - team availability)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@brightmed.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@brightmed.com>, BrightMed Scheduling <scheduling@brightmed.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightMed Renewal QBR - Prefer condensed day?

Alice —

Thanks for the note and the availability file. Short answer: yes, we can do a condensed "Showcase Day". High-level proposal from our side:

- Format: 3 sessions (30 / 45 / 30 mins) with a 15-minute buffer between blocks for handoff.
- Hosts: primary host + technical backup for the API deep-dive. Rishi will be primary; Priyom will be backup and run the recording ops.
- Recording & consent: we can display a one-click consent notice at session start and redact PII from transcripts if needed.
- Deliverables: short ops runbook + agenda and run-of-show. I'll attach our template and a proposed agenda in the follow-up.

Two options for timing given your CSV:
1) Single-day morning block (PST): 09:00 / 10:00 / 11:15 — allows execs to wrap before lunch.
2) Single-day afternoon block (PST): 13:00 / 14:00 / 15:15 — if you prefer post-lunch.

If you need APAC-friendly timing we can shift the middle block and have a recorded segment for the observer.

Action items for you:
- Carlos: confirm which option (morning vs afternoon) works best.
- Alice: confirm the attendee list for each block (execs vs technical).

I'll attach the runbook template now.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-runbook-template.md (Markdown - session ops runbook template)
